title: Normalize interleaved stream offsets and finalize credits
creator: Priya Shah
description: Users have reported intermittent overcharging and negative reconciliation adjustments for long-running streaming sessions that interleave multiple logical fragments (prefix + prompt + midstream user edits). The issue manifests when reconnects, partial-frame retries, or in-flight model-switch fallbacks reorder fragments; the metering pipeline sometimes double-counts tokens or leaves provisional credits unresolved. This ticket standardizes offset handling, makes final-credit paths idempotent, and ensures recovered sessions reconcile deterministically.
problem_statement: The metering pipeline assumes monotonically increasing fragment offsets per session but does not enforce or validate sequence ids across network reconnects and model-switch fallbacks. Reordering and duplicate fragments lead to both over- and under-crediting in downstream ledger entries.
root_cause_analysis: Investigation showed three contributing factors: 1) client-initiated reconnects can replay partial frames without session-level sequence stamps; 2) the streaming ingress normalizes token counts per-chunk but lacks a canonical finalization checkpoint; 3) the ledger write path accepts provisional credits and later mirrors with a non-idempotent delta update. Repro steps: run a simulated WS client that sends prefix A, prompt B, then disconnects mid-prompt; on reconnect it resends leftover suffix B', server merges fragments and triggers fallback model switch; observed ledger entries show duplicate output tokens and provisional credits that were not reconciled by the compensating job.
proposed_solution: 1) Introduce a session-scoped monotonically increasing fragment_seq_id that the runtime stamps on each fragment at ingress; 2) Add 'finalize_credit' atomic operation in the metering service that is idempotent by (session_id, fragment_seq_id); 3) Extend streaming protocol to include optional client-sent fragment_seq_hint for best-effort alignment; 4) Change ledger write to use upserts keyed by (session_id, fragment_seq_id, role=input|output) and make the provisional flag explicit; 5) Add a reconciliation worker that emits compensation events for any provisional credits older than TTL and mark anomalies for manual review.
acceptance_criteria: All streaming sessions issue credits that are deterministic and idempotent even after reconnects or reorderings
No duplicate ledger entries for the same (session_id, fragment_seq_id, role)
Automated tests simulate reconnect/replay/model-switch and show zero net overcharge across 1M synthetic sessions
Reconciliation worker reduces provisional-credit backlog to 0 for test workloads within 5 minutes
Monitoring alerts fire for >0.1% anomaly rate in production within 24 hours of rollout
tasks: Design: update protocol spec to include fragment_seq_id and finalize semantics (Priya)
Backend: augment streaming ingress to stamp fragment_seq_id and persist with session checkpoints (Daniel)
Database: create upsert-safe ledger schema and migrations (ENG-DB team)
Worker: implement reconciliation worker and compensation event emitter (Daniel)
SDK: add best-effort fragment_seq_hint support to JS/Go SDKs (SDK team)
End-to-end tests: build synthetic harness that replays reconnects/model-switch scenarios (QA)
Canary rollout: feature flag gating and 10% traffic ramp (SRE)
Postmortem: add notes to incident playbook and update billing FAQ (PM)
test_plan: Unit tests for idempotent finalize_credit operation covering duplicate idempotency token cases
Integration tests with simulated websocket reconnects and out-of-order fragments verifying ledger upserts
Load test: 1M synthetic streaming sessions with random disconnects to validate reconciliation worker throughput
Property-based test: assert ledger invariants (no duplicates, credits sum equals observed tokens) across fuzzed sequences
Manual test: run cross-region model-fallback scenario and inspect canary metrics
rollout_plan: Gate change behind a feature flag on runtime and metering-service. Deploy DB migration in a backward-compatible mode (create new table/indexes, do not delete old schema). Enable fragment_seq stamping at 10% of runtime pods and run E2E smoke tests. Enable finalize_credit path and reconciliation worker in staging. Ramp to 30% after 24h with anomaly checks, then 100% if metrics stable. If anomaly rate exceeds threshold, rollback feature flag and trigger incident runbook.
monitoring_and_alerts: canary_billing_delta > 0.05% relative to baseline -> alert SRE + Billing
